description: On a writable copy of the base fixture, QRet is created with SELECT ID FROM T; and held. Its SQL is then set in turn to a delete, a crosstab, a make-table, a parameterized select and a UNION ALL statement, and finally back to the select. After creation and after each set, Name, Type, SQL, Connect, ReturnsRecords, Updatable, RecordsAffected, Parameters and Fields of the held QueryDef are read.
retentionNote: Designed r-cat-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.

args.text: TRANSFORM Sum(B) AS SB SELECT A FROM T GROUP BY A PIVOT ID;
SELECT ID, A INTO TNew FROM T;
PARAMETERS pId Long, pName Text ( 20 ); SELECT ID, A FROM T WHERE ID = pId OR A = pName;
SELECT ID, A FROM T UNION ALL SELECT ID, A FROM W;
SELECT ID, A, B * 2 AS Twice FROM T WHERE B > 5 ORDER BY ID;
